issue_context.title: Automatic zoom not correct with odd or even spreads
issue_context.body:
Attach (recommended) or Link to PDF file here:

Configuration:
- Web browser and its version: Firefox nightly
- Operating system and its version: linux debian

Steps to reproduce the problem:
1. open https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/web/viewer.html 
2. set spread to odd or even and zoom to automatic

What is the expected behavior? (add screenshot)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5641725/101290851-fb2d3280-3804-11eb-8f28-529559bea709.png)


What went wrong? (add screenshot)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5641725/101290787-b2757980-3804-11eb-8e48-5db132171ea3.png)

review_comments: If I look at https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/d784af3f38d5604b653c06fb40a6fe6a021d45d3/web/base_viewer.js#L1412-L1416 this happens _before_ `_setCurrentPageNumber` and `update`. Shouldn't that be done here as well?

> Shouldn't that be done here as well?

You're absolutely right, this needs to be changed; otherwise there's a risk that the active page changes.
